posts.title: Booting with EFI
posts.description: I’ve written a new post on how to boot using EFI from a DHCP server and deploying ISO images. in the example I use Oracle Linux 8.9 which is RHEL 8.9 with a few extra branding files. The link to the content is here: https://off-grid-engineering.com/2024/03/28/efi-booting-rhel-centos-oracle-linux-8-environments/ Enjoy!
